description: This file defines an interface `JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider` in Java, which provides a method to extract authorization subjects from a JSON Web Token (`JsonWebToken`). It is part of a security/authentication package related to JWT token handling within a larger Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: JwtAuthorizationSubjectsProvider
classes.description: An interface that declares a method for retrieving authorization subjects from a JSON Web Token.

methods.name: getAuthorizationSubjects
methods.description: Returns a list of AuthorizationSubject objects contained within the provided JsonWebToken. Throws NullPointerException if the input token is null.
